title: 🌸 Ayurvedic Treatment for PCOD, PCOS & Hormonal Imbalance in India
intro: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) and Polycystic Ovary Disorder (PCOD) affect millions of women worldwide, leading to irregular periods, infertility, weight gain, acne, and hormonal imbalance. Ayurveda treats PCOD/PCOS by addressing the root cause — hormonal imbalance and metabolic disorders — through personalized therapies, herbal medicines, diet, and lifestyle correction. Unlike conventional treatments, Ayurveda provides long-term relief without side effects.

sections.heading: Benefits of Ayurvedic Treatment for PCOD & Hormonal Imbalance
points: Restores natural menstrual cycles
Regulates ovulation & improves fertility
Balances hormones (reduces excess androgens)
Helps with weight management & insulin resistance
Clears acne, pigmentation & hair growth issues
Reduces stress, anxiety, and improves sleep

sections.heading: Ayurvedic Therapies for PCOD & Hormonal Care
points: Panchakarma Detox: Removes toxins, balances doshas, improves metabolism
Virechana (Purgation Therapy): Cleanses the liver and improves hormone regulation
Basti (Medicated Enema): Balances Vata dosha & improves reproductive health
Shirodhara (Oil Drip Therapy): Calms the nervous system & regulates stress hormones
Herbal Medicines (Ashoka, Shatavari, Lodhra): Support menstrual health & fertility
Customized Diet & Yoga Plans: Regulate weight, boost fertility & reduce insulin resistance

sections.heading: Why Choose Ayurveda for PCOD/PCOS in India?

Affordable treatment plans in India’s Ayurveda centers
